reading.title: Tollgate Yard property tax reduction request

candidates.quote: Tollgate Yard is a proposed building of 150 homes on Tollgate Road.
The applicant would set aside 30 of the 150 homes as affordable homes.
Those homes would be for households at or below 70 percent of area median income.
Staff recommends that the Council approve a 12-year property tax reduction for Tollgate Yard.
